summary: Sets the vehicle AI callToBox flag (vehicle+0x454C) to the input value when it is 0 or 1; larger values are ignored. Returns the input unchanged. Called per-frame from the AI main update and related AI callbacks.

operations.description: Only performs the field write when a2 <= 1; values greater than 1 are silently ignored and the field keeps its prior value.
this[4435] = a2 writes the callToBox flag at vehicle+0x454C (AI command_input) to 0 or 1.
Returns the input value a2 unchanged (result = a2).
